entities.summary: Cody Layne Wallace is an American former professional football player who was a guard and center in the National Football League (NFL). He was selected by the San Francisco 49ers in the fourth round of the 2008 NFL draft. He played college football for the Texas A&M Aggies. Wallace was also a member of the New York Jets, Detroit Lions, Houston Texans, Tampa Bay Buccaneers, and Pittsburgh Steelers.
